$comment: Sourced from the live site (github.com/andrewkriley/www-andrewriley-info, src/app/globals.css) — not exploratory placeholders. The `dark` branch mirrors that site's @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) overrides.

primary.description: Cobalt — primary actions, key links, brand anchor

primaryMuted.description: Sky — eyebrows, secondary highlights, section accents (site's brand-secondary)

accent.description: Lime — high-energy accents and small emphasis moments

growth.description: Growth green — making, progress, DIY, positive-state highlights

sky.description: Air — soft surfaces and glows; becomes the primary color in dark mode

linkHover.description: The site itself doesn't shift link color on hover; this darkens toward primary for on-brand interactive feedback.

inverse.description: Text used on the inverse (sky) surface — unchanged between light and dark mode

onPrimary.description: Filled-primary button text. The site's own primary button pairs a light surface with dark text in both modes, so this needs no separate dark override.

onAccent.description: Text on the lime accent — white would be nearly invisible on such a light color.

sans.description: Overrides the shared Source Sans 3 default for this profile only — the live site runs on Inter throughout, no serif.

button.description: Site buttons are fully pilled, not the shared radius.md rectangle.
